steps.speaker: Security Personnel
steps.content: Situation contained, hostile neutralized, Chief! The area is now secure. Thank you for your assistance!
They look at you with admiration and offer an awkward imitation of an FAC salute.

steps.speaker: Security Personnel
steps.content: Then, we'll get back to work now.

steps.speaker: Security Personnel
steps.content: <size=25>(Whoa... first time seeing the real deal. So that's the MBCC Chief? Way more low-key than I expected. I didn't even notice...)</size>
The security personnel look visibly moved.

steps.speaker: Security Personnel
steps.content: You did all the real work there. Thank you for your efforts! We'll take it from here.

steps.speaker: Security Personnel
steps.content: Roger that!

After the security personnel leave, you turn toward the other side where the Outland exhibitor in charge of the booth huddles like a cornered animal, her face deathly pale as she spews frantic explanations.

steps.speaker: Outland Exhibitor
steps.content: @#@%%......&#*¥%#!! (I'm sorry, I'm so sorry! I swear it wasn't on purpose! We mean no harm to DisCity! We're clueless about what went wrong! Please, believe me, I'm begging you!)

steps.speaker: Option
options: You should go check if you're injured first.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: DisCity always looks out for victims. Everything's alright now. Take all the time you need to recover.

steps.speaker: Outland Exhibitor
steps.content: #¥@#%@*& (*sob*... Thank you so much...)
You calm the startled exhibitors, personally guiding them toward the kindest medics on duty. The smile on your face never wavers until at last the crowd thins.
Then, a faint electronic chime pulses from your coat pocket as a black triangular object quietly pokes its tip out.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Nicely managed. This allows us to assess their Mania levels under medical supervision.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Any incidents at the Great Expo would impact diplomatic relations, which are particularly delicate right now. We must prevent any escalation into conflict. Chief, you might even have a talent for diplomacy.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Really? Can I apply for a career change then?
I see you've developed a talent for humor.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: That was just my attempt at humor. EDGE has implanted a new simulation module that adapts to mimic the speech patterns of those around you, which is meant to help you relax occasionally. Please don't take it seriously.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: A career change for you is impossible. No rational person would allow it. Please continue performing your duties as you always have. You've been doing an excellent job. Ha-ha.
...You make a mental note to file a complaint. Their humor simulation module clearly needs serious work.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Yes, EDGE has implanted a new simulation module that adapts to mimic the speech patterns of those around you, which is meant to help you relax occasionally.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: If you find it amusing, that would be ideal. I will keep gathering feedback for future improvements. Thank you for your encouragement. Kindly consider leaving a positive review on the version experience report. Ha-ha.
Your custom-made Schorl emits an unsettling mechanical "laugh," making you wonder if EDGE's understanding of humor might be somewhat different from the rest of humanity.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: But in retrospect, the incident doesn't appear to have a significant impact. The undercover FAC agents in the vicinity could have managed it effectively. Even without your involvement, the likelihood of casualties was low. Your exposure in this case has yielded limited advantages with notable costs.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Given your high-profile status, we must make adjustments to your initially assigned security mission. You'll have to return to the command center for now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I agree that adjustments are necessary, but... do I really have to go back?

The mechanisms of Aurum Secretum remain unclear, and the monsters' sudden rampage suggests something ominous—a conspiracy, perhaps. Is this truly just an accident caused by unstable Aurum Secretum technology? Or...
Someone has deliberately staged this low-damage "accident," creating a situation with minimal losses, all for one purpose: to force you into the light.
[Outside the Screen]

On the other side of the screen, the Nirvana representative continues to grumble in frustration, while Parfait quietly observes the figure in the frame. After a long moment, she finally turns around and silences her friend with a smile.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Patience, my friend. Didn't we agree that everything would be settled at my dinner party?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: I intend to explore the exhibition in depth over the coming days. Are there any delicacies that particularly tempt your palate? I've secured Chef Alba's exclusive participation this time, and I must admit, Fraser's culinary delights have piqued my curiosity as well.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Let's look forward to the feast that awaits us that evening.
[At the Exhibition Hall]
You scan the venue and easily spot a distinctive man standing there, watching. As if he's been there for quite some time.
When he notices your gaze, the man gives a slight bow and smiles at you. Schorl trembles slightly, as if wanting to add something more.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Looks like I can't leave just yet. Someone's clearly inviting me over.
